name: Piercing Blood
combo: ranged poke; a third-party wiki lists '4 M1 -> Piercing Blood -> Supernova' as a melee confirm
when_it_whiffs: base beam can be blocked and only reaches about 30 studs
description: Fires compressed blood as a thin beam about 30 studs long. Listed as blockable and interruptible, but it cannot be countered. One rblxguide search summary gave a 20 s cooldown; Fandom, bloxodes and rblxguide's own tier-list total (55 s across the four base moves) all agree on 15 s.

name: Piercing Blood (charged, uses an orb)
combo: finisher after detonating an aerial Flowing Red Scale blood mine (Fandom)
when_it_whiffs: needs a Convergence orb and a hold of at least 1.35 s; without an orb it stays the base beam
description: Holding the move for 1.35 s or longer spends one Convergence orb to double the beam's range and knockback (30 studs doubled, so about 60). Listed as unblockable, 20 damage (was 28, then 24, lowered to 20 in V1.67).

name: Flowing Red Scale
damage: 13 (3 per rush hit, 4 on the last); 17 with a Convergence orb (last kick 8)
air: grounded version; used while airborne it becomes a different move (see air variants)
combo: hit-confirm dash, ends by ragdolling the target away
when_it_whiffs: the short forward dash has to connect; blockable from all sides
description: Short forward dash. If it connects the user does 2 punches and 2 kicks and then ragdolls the target away. With a Convergence orb available the final kick spends it for a blood explosion that doubles that kick's damage. Tagged blockable from all sides, interruptible, bypasses ragdoll. An older games.gg guide lists 17.3 / 25.3 damage; Fandom, bloxodes and rblxguide list 13 / 17.

name: Flowing Red Scale (air)
air: air-only variant: used while the user is airborne
combo: launcher, ragdolls the target upward
when_it_whiffs: must be airborne and on top of the target
description: Used in the air it becomes a downward axe kick that ragdolls the target upward. Listed as unblockable, 6 damage (reduced from 10), with 5 self-damage noted on the wiki.

name: Flowing Red Scale (air, with orb: blood mine)
air: air-only variant: needs to be airborne and have a Convergence orb
combo: setup; wiki notes detonating the mine into a charged Piercing Blood as a finisher
when_it_whiffs: mine is static, so the target has to be within its 10-stud radius when detonated; also hurts the user
description: Airborne with an orb, the user drops a static, intangible blood mine underneath. Pressing the special (even while stunned or ragdolled) detonates it, damaging and knocking away everyone within 10 studs, the user included (it cannot kill or ragdoll the user; 15 self-damage listed).

name: Supernova (no orbs: counter)
combo: on success grants 4 Convergence orbs and stays off cooldown
when_it_whiffs: needs the opponent to hit the user with a melee attack inside the 0.6 s counter window
description: With no orbs held, Supernova is a melee counter with a 0.6 s window. Landing it true-ragdolls the attacker, gives 4 Convergence orbs without spending Awakening and skips the cooldown; missing it puts it on a 15 s cooldown. Counter damage was 7.5 before V1.54. If the target has 7 HP or less it triggers an instant-kill finisher.

name: Supernova (with orbs: thrown blood bomb)
combo: orb spender; detonated manually with the special
when_it_whiffs: getting stunned makes the orb dissipate; cannot be used when four orbs are already active
description: With orbs available the user throws a Convergence orb that becomes a blood bomb, detonated by pressing the special. 8 damage (lowered from 10), 4 s cooldown.

name: Blood Edge
combo: knocks the target away; finisher version stabs twelve times then kicks away (15 damage kick)
description: Semi-blockable (part of the move can be blocked; the wiki does not say which part). The user stabs with the left blood dagger, flips forward and slams the floor with the right one, sending the opponent away. Failing the stab does not cancel the follow-up. The finisher is listed as unblockable and, per a forum post, gives 4 orbs since V1.67.

name: Convergence
combo: sets up empowered versions of the other moves and switches Supernova from counter to orb bomb
when_it_whiffs: cannot be used while at least one orb remains
description: Conjures 4 condensed blood orbs. Orbs strengthen other attacks and change how Supernova behaves. Listed with a 20 s cooldown and a 10% Awakening cost.

name: Convergence (awakening: homing orb after Wing King)
combo: follow-up after Wing King; the orb stuns on contact
when_it_whiffs: needs orbs left after Wing King and a target within 75 studs
description: After Wing King any available orbs form a halo. Aiming at a target within 75 studs and pressing the special releases one orb that homes in on them, circles their position for 5 seconds and stuns on contact.

name: Slicing Exorcism
air: jumping before use removes the camera lock
combo: ragdolls anyone hit to the floor; has an instant-kill finisher
when_it_whiffs: uses the available Convergence orbs, so it is weak or unusable without them; camera is locked while firing
description: Shapes the available Convergence orbs into a pressurised stream with a maximum range of 66 studs that ragdolls anyone hit to the floor. Damage scales with the number of orbs (17.5 listed) and the cooldown is +3.25 s per orb up to 13 s. The unblockable tag came through jumbled in the wiki extract and may belong to a variant.

name: Wing King
damage: 43.75 (28.75 flurry, 15 pull and slam) per bloxodes
combo: leads into homing Convergence orbs; no endlag whether it hits or not
when_it_whiffs: the long-range arm extension can be blocked
description: Lunging flurry of kicks and punches with a long-range arm extension that pulls an enemy in for a punch. Has melee and bullet invincibility frames. The hand extension deals blockable bullet damage; blockability of the flurry is not stated. V1.67 removed its endlag and its true ragdoll.

name: Blood Rain
damage: 2 per tick, 0.5 per tick on block
combo: area pressure
when_it_whiffs: only reaches 35 studs from the user; blocking cuts it to chip damage
description: A blood sphere rains pellets over a wide area, hitting anything within 35 studs of the user. Blocking reduces the damage to 0.5 per tick rather than stopping it. Drains the Awakening bar faster while active.

name: Plasma Wave
damage: 104 (~7.42 per tick) per Fandom; 95 per bloxodes (more recent); 116 per an older games.gg guide
combo: ultimate; more damage the closer the target is
when_it_whiffs: long spin-up before the cone fires; the last tick does not always hit
description: Maximum technique: the user spins, creating 14 blood orbs, then fires a massive forward cone with a 120-stud range that does more damage at close range. Unblockable, with i-frames during the spin. A later patch stopped the final tick from ragdolling enemies away.

name: Duty as a Brother (awakening)
description: Name bloxodes gives to Blood Manipulator's awakening. It swaps the kit to Slicing Exorcism, Wing King, Blood Rain and Plasma Wave, with Convergence still on the special. Character HP is listed as 100.

name: Swift Kick
combo: kick stuns, then grab and toss; wiki tech: uppercut, missed Pebble Throw, then Swift Kick to un-ragdoll and stun, then Boogie Woogie for an M1 reset
when_it_whiffs: the opening kick can be blocked; feinting it ends the kick's stun early
description: Semi-blockable: the opening kick is blockable, the grab-and-throw that follows is not. Interruptible and feintable (7.5 s cooldown if feinted early). Cooldown was cut by 2.5 s in V1.81; an older community post lists 17 s and 17 damage (7 kick, 10 grab and throw). The damage split came through a search summary and may be slightly garbled.

name: Brute Force
damage: 17.5 (6 if only the wind gust hits)
combo: heavy knockback hit
when_it_whiffs: if the target is not close enough only the weaker shockwave hits (less damage and knockback)
description: Unblockable heavy strike. Out of direct range the attack's wind gust / shockwave hits instead for 6 damage and lower knockback. Feintable (8.5 s cooldown if feinted early). V1.81 cut the cooldown by 3 s; an older community post lists 20 s.

name: Pebble Throw
combo: a hit stuns for half a second and instantly stands a ragdolled enemy back up (setup for swaps and resets)
when_it_whiffs: cannot hit ragdolled players within 20 studs of the user; blockable
description: Throws a pebble for 4 bullet damage. Blockable, interruptible, and only partly bypasses ragdoll: it will not hit a ragdolled player who is within 20 studs. Boogie Woogie also has an item-swap use with a 3 s cooldown.

name: Elbow Drop
air: uppercut launches the target, then the user jumps after them for the elbow slam
combo: launcher into slam
when_it_whiffs: the opening uppercut is a close-range hit; a community post says it does not hit ragdolled targets
description: The user crouches, uppercuts the opponent, then jumps after them and drops an elbow. Unblockable and interruptible, feintable (8 s cooldown if feinted early). V1.81 cut the cooldown by 4 s; an older community post lists 20 s and 10 damage, plus a 30-damage cutscene version.

name: Boogie Woogie
combo: repositioning tool that links moves together and is used for M1 resets
when_it_whiffs: needs a target within 60 studs; a target further than 35 studs (45 after a later +10 stud patch) can block the swap
description: The user claps and instantly swaps places and facing with a target within 60 studs. No damage. Semi-blockable: blockable from all sides, but unblockable when the target is within 35 studs (a later patch added 10 studs). Infobox cooldown is 6 s, 3 s on block; the page text also describes a 1 s cooldown for swaps within 35 studs and 2 s for 36 to 60 studs, doubled if blocked. Item swap has a 3 s cooldown. The awakening version is listed with the same cooldown.

name: Idol's Debut
combo: first punch launches, then a cutscene kick slams the target to the floor
when_it_whiffs: the cutscene only triggers if the first punch launches an enemy
description: Unblockable, interruptible punch. If it launches an enemy the user gains total i-frames while a cutscene plays in which the idol (the user, from everyone else's view) kicks the target down to the floor. An older community post lists 42.4 damage, which is Climax Jumping's figure.

name: Climax Jumping
damage: 42.4 (1 lunge, 27.4 barrage at 1.2 per hit, 15 uptilt)
combo: lunge into barrage, ends with an uptilt launcher
when_it_whiffs: the opening lunge has to connect
description: Lunge that leads into a long barrage and a finishing uptilt. games.gg lists the 42.4 damage as unblockable. Fandom lists a 22 s cooldown; a tagged community post says it was changed from 22 s to 18 s.

name: Dreams
combo: first two punches knock back slightly, the third ragdolls the target away
when_it_whiffs: three forward punches, so the target has to stay in front through the knockback
description: The user spreads their arms and throws 3 heavy forward punches. It is a strike, not a grab.

name: Brothers
damage: 80 on a successful counter; 70 if nothing is countered (games.gg)
combo: big punish: swaps in Yuji for a Black Flash
when_it_whiffs: needs the opponent to throw a melee attack during the 1.1 s counter window
description: The user holds a high-five pose for 1.1 s. A melee attack during the window is interrupted and Boogie Woogie swaps the user with Yuji Itadori, who lands the hit. games.gg and a forum post describe a miss variant that still swaps with Yuji; they disagree on its damage (70 vs 80).

name: False Memories (awakening)
description: Switcher's awakening. Heals 20 HP, is uninterruptible, lasts 60 s and swaps the kit to Idol's Debut, Climax Jumping, Dreams and Brothers with Boogie Woogie still on the special. Base HP 100.

name: Extended Swings
combo: three swings into a slam; a hit cancels the target's ragdoll so the next swings connect; finisher is an instant kill
when_it_whiffs: swings cannot hit grounded ragdolled targets; first hits can be blocked and countered
description: Three gavel swings followed by a slam. Tagged blockable, interruptible, partly bypasses ragdoll (tags were jumbled in the extract). A patch lowered the first hits' damage by 3 and made them counterable.

name: Justice Served
air: freezes before the slam if there is no ground underneath to hit
combo: follow-up: used right after the Pressing Charges kick it only goes on a 7 s cooldown
when_it_whiffs: needs ground to slam on; has a wind-up (25% faster if the user was unarmed before using it)
description: A wind-up slam. Blockability is not stated in the text that was retrieved.

name: Judgement's Reach
air: against airborne targets it becomes the Grapple variant
combo: interrupt tool: if it interrupts the target's action they cough blood and are stunned much longer
description: A reaching hit with pushback. Blocking does not stop the pushback (base blockability otherwise not clearly stated); the long stun only applies when it interrupts an action other than blocking. Its finisher is semi-blockable and an instant kill. It replaced the old Grapple move.

name: Pressing Charges
damage: 7.5 (4 kick, 3.5 swing); the swing does 14.5 as a finisher on targets at 14.5 HP or less
combo: two-part: kick then swing; pressing again right after the kick triggers the swing early; leads into Justice Served on a reduced cooldown
when_it_whiffs: the kick's stun is never long enough to guarantee both hits connect
description: A kick followed by a gavel swing. The finisher version (14.5 swing, 15 dropkick) is listed as blockable and interruptible; the base tags were jumbled in the extract.

name: No Escape
combo: gap closer: pressing the special again before the gavel returns does a quick short hop toward the target
when_it_whiffs: a gavel that hits nothing flies 50 studs and returns after 0.75 s
description: Launches the gavel for 3 bullet damage that bypasses ragdoll. If it touches a target, even a blocking one, it takes three times as long to return, and re-pressing the special hops the user toward them. It can be recalled early to avoid the cooldown. Infobox cooldown is 5 s; an update log line mentions 14 s, so the current value is unclear. It does not pull or stun the target.

name: Domain Amplification
combo: defensive: absorbs one hit
when_it_whiffs: only about half a second of i-frames; cannot stop all damage or stun from multi-hit attacks
description: Awakening special. Creates roughly half a second of total i-frames that absorb a hit. Costs 5% Awakening, with an 8 s cooldown after it is dispelled.

name: Execution
damage: 25 (10 lunge, 15 toss); executes a target that already has 2 Execution stacks (310 per games.gg)
combo: applies an Execution stack; the third stack kills
when_it_whiffs: the forward lunge has to catch the target
description: The user dashes forward with the Executioner's Sword, gaining melee i-frames, then tosses the target. Each hit applies an Execution stack and a target caught while already holding 2 stacks is executed.

name: Final Judgement
damage: 10 for the lunge's swing, 300 for the stab; games.gg: 300 if the QTE is won, 35 if it is failed
combo: kill move decided by a quick-time event
when_it_whiffs: hard to land (the wiki says so directly); failing the QTE drops it to minor damage
description: A lunge with a sword swing that starts a QTE minigame; winning it lands a 300-damage stab.

name: Verdict
damage: 5 + 5; 300 on execution (one wiki line says reduced to 50; a patch note mentions 45 on block)
combo: applies an Execution stack on an unblocked hit; kills a target that already has two stacks
when_it_whiffs: if blocked the target dodges and no stack is applied
description: A sword-hilt knockback followed by a dashing slash. The execution damage figures conflict between the page and its update log.

name: Triple Sentence
combo: each throw that lands applies an Execution stack; press two or three times to throw that many times
when_it_whiffs: hard to land (the wiki says so directly); each extra throw adds 6 s of cooldown
description: The Executioner's Sword is thrown forward to sever a limb and apply an Execution stack. Cooldown is 12 s plus 6 s per extra throw.

name: Grapple
air: only comes out against airborne targets
combo: anti-air: slams an airborne target to the ground with a true ragdoll
when_it_whiffs: target has to be airborne; blockable
description: On the current wiki, Grapple is the variant of Judgement's Reach: the gavel latches onto an airborne target and sends them crashing to the ground. Tagged blockable, interruptible, bypasses ragdoll, true ragdoll. It has an instant-kill finisher. It is also the name of an older base move that pulled and stunned the target, which Judgement's Reach replaced. The wiki's own awakening list is Execution, Final Judgement, Verdict, Triple Sentence, with Domain Amplification on the special; where the awakening Grapple slot fits was not found.

name: Deadly Sentencing (domain) / Death Penalty
combo: gate to the awakened kit
when_it_whiffs: the awakened moves need the Death Penalty outcome
description: Defense Attorney has to meet requirements before truly awakening. When the domain collapses the outcome is one of: Innocence (caster gets 60% Awakening back), Confiscation (everyone inside loses held items permanently or 2 random abilities for 1 min 30 s), or Death Penalty (the gavel breaks to reveal the Executioner's Sword). games.gg says the Death Penalty form heals 60 HP.

name: Severing Path
combo: slide-in starter that locks the target and ends with a launching katana swing
when_it_whiffs: the forward slide has to reach the target
description: The user slides forward, locks onto the target and finishes with a launching katana swing. Cooldown went from 18 s to 15 s in V1.78. Holding backward while using it gives the Veilstep back-roll instead.

name: Resolute Slash
combo: has an instant-kill finisher
when_it_whiffs: cannot hit ragdolled targets
description: Sword slash tagged unblockable, interruptible, cannot bypass ragdoll. Its base damage was not in the text retrieved. Cooldown 18 s to 15 s in V1.78. A year-old forum post describes an older version where a second use on block dealt 8 damage and knocked the target away without stun.

name: Veilstep
combo: retreat / reposition
when_it_whiffs: does no damage; it is a back-roll away from the target
description: No longer a standalone move: V1.76 replaced Veilstep and Revolve with Outburst and Second Wind. It survives as the backward variant of Severing Path: holding backward makes the user back-roll about 27 studs with melee i-frames. The old standalone move had a dive (10 damage, 18 s cooldown as of V1.67.1).

name: Second Wind
combo: dash-in grab into a slam; a failed first use can be followed by a second attempt
when_it_whiffs: the dash grab has to catch the target (no cooldown if the first use fails)
description: A dash that grabs and slams the target. V1.79 gave the dash melee i-frames, slightly enlarged the hitbox and raised grab damage from 1 to 2 and slam damage from 6 to 8.

name: Outburst
damage: sword swing 2 or 4 (the patch note is self-contradictory)
combo: parry: a successful parry gives melee and bullet i-frames for the length of both players' stun
when_it_whiffs: the parry only happens if the user is hit within 0.25 s of using it; otherwise it is a plain swing
description: A sword swing that doubles as a parry: if the user is hit within 0.25 s of pressing it, the swing parries the incoming attack (listed as a bullet counter). Cooldown was not in the text retrieved.

name: Revolve
description: Removed as a base move in V1.76 (replaced, together with Veilstep, by Outburst and Second Wind). An earlier patch lowered its damage. No description of what it did was found.

name: Rika
combo: summon that gives access to a second moveset
when_it_whiffs: Rika cannot go further than 100 studs from the user
description: Summons Rika. Pressing the special again once she is out switches from the user's moveset to hers; she is recalled when the special is pressed again or after she uses a move. Her base moves all share one cooldown, shown on the special bar. In awakening she has 4 different moves that do not share cooldowns.

name: Rika Downslam
damage: 12 (8 on contact, 4 on the second impact); 10 against airborne targets
description: Rika move, made unblockable in a patch. Shares the Rika base-move cooldown.

name: Rika Launch
description: Rika move that deals no damage. Cooldown is 10 s, or 6 s if it feints. What it launches was not in the text retrieved.

name: Rika Slam
combo: grab into repeated slams
when_it_whiffs: the target can evade the grab early
description: Rika grabs the target and slams them repeatedly. A search summary placed it in the awakening Rika set; treat the slot as uncertain.

name: Rika Haymaker
combo: block punish: does more damage to a blocking target
description: Rika punch that bypasses block and deals 6 extra damage to a blocking target. The update log says it was made awakening-only at one point, but the page lists it with her base moves.

name: Rika Grab
combo: held a ragdolled target in place briefly
when_it_whiffs: only worked on a ragdolled target
description: Removed move. Rika grabbed a ragdolled target for a short moment or until they took damage. It was first in her base moveset, then moved to her awakening moveset, then removed and replaced by the awakening move Copy Wheel.

name: Rika Throw
damage: 8 to 18 to the target; 0.5 to 22 to the user on a miss
when_it_whiffs: missing damages the user instead (0.5 to 22)
description: Rika throw with variable damage. On a miss the user takes the damage. Slot inferred from the page's ordering and uncertain.

name: Rika Smash
combo: bounces the target upward
description: Rika's fist grows as it is raised above the target, then slams down and makes them bounce upward. A patch lowered its damage by 2. Shares the Rika base-move cooldown.

name: True Love Beam
damage: 117 per an older games.gg guide (reduced in V1.75)
description: Awakening beam. In V1.76 it was moved into Rika's moveset and Energy Ripple took its place in the user's own awakening set. A smaller variant has a 15 s cooldown. No current damage, cooldown or range figures were found.

name: Authentic Mutual Love
description: Cursed Partners' domain. games.gg says it lasts 45 seconds. No damage, cooldown or range figures were found.

name: Elbow Rush
description: Awakening melee attack. Damage was cut to 11 in V1.76 and restored to 15 in V1.77. No cooldown or description was found.

name: Copy
description: Awakening move (Copy Wheel) that uses techniques the user has copied; Cursed Speech is the default variant. Copying a technique again no longer resets its cooldown. It replaced Rika Grab. No damage or cooldown figures were found.

name: Energy Ripple
combo: pushes all enemies away (space maker)
when_it_whiffs: only reaches 27 studs around the user
description: The user drives the cursed tool into the floor and creates a field that pushes away all enemies within 27 studs. V1.77 raised damage from 14 to 19 and the radius by 25%. Replaced True Love Beam in the user's awakening set in V1.76.

name: Ultra Spin
combo: drill into slam; with Offload the puppet version uppercuts, which sets up a held Ultra Cannon
when_it_whiffs: blockable on the current wiki page
description: A drilling spin that ends in a slam. Current wiki tags it blockable and interruptible; an older community post says the regular variant is unblockable and launches the enemy away. Used through Offload, the puppet spins in the air and drops onto the target.

name: Boost On
combo: grab confirm; one guide's flow is Offload Ultra Spin, puppet pressure, Boost On, then Heat Emission
when_it_whiffs: the grab has to connect
description: A grab followed by a blast. Tagged unblockable and interruptible.

name: Ultra Cannon
combo: wiki tip: start it right after an uppercut so the target is still ragdolled when it fires
when_it_whiffs: blockable from all sides
description: A cannon shot. Tap for a quick shot; the shot can be delayed by holding, but only for about a second (holding 1.3 s turns it into Ultimate Cannon). Close range causes knockback. The Offload puppet version tracks the cursor and fires when the user starts blocking.

name: Ultimate Cannon (Ultra Cannon held 1.3 s)
combo: the opening explosion ragdolls nearby targets; the beam ragdolls the target away at the end
when_it_whiffs: 1.3 s hold before anything comes out; interruptible
description: Holding Ultra Cannon for 1.3 s switches the puppet to Mode: Albatross. A small explosion around the user ragdolls nearby targets (it no longer deals damage), then a continuous 17-tick beam fires. Tagged unblockable, interruptible, bypasses ragdoll, explosion damage. The beam makes the target immune to melee until it ragdolls them away.

name: Heat Emission
combo: ender in one guide's suggested flow
when_it_whiffs: the use-twice variant is blockable from all sides
description: Explosion-damage attack tagged unblockable. Using the move twice gives a weaker variant (9 damage) that is blockable from all sides. The area shape was not described in the text retrieved; 'area around the user' is a reading of the name and damage type.

name: Offload
combo: makes the next move come out through an expendable puppet, so the user can act at the same time
when_it_whiffs: switches itself off after 15 seconds if no move is used
description: Base special. Wraps the puppet in cursed energy so the next move is performed by an expendable puppet, which explodes when it hits or finishes its task (the explosion causes no stun, knockback or ragdoll). Using it while on cooldown used to trigger Ubercharge; the update log both re-adds (V1.75) and removes that, so check in game.

name: Energy Output
combo: raises the power and cost of the next awakening move
when_it_whiffs: resets to level 1 after any move, or if pressed at level 5
description: Awakening special. Each press steps a 5-segment bar up one output level: the higher the level, the stronger the next move and the higher its Awakening cost (+1 month per level). No cooldown.

name: Miracle Cannon
when_it_whiffs: the big sphere needs Energy Output level 2 or higher
description: Cannon shot costing 1 month of stored energy. At Energy Output level 2 or higher it spends 2 months to charge a massive sphere for 35 damage.

name: Pigeon Viola
combo: long-range homing pressure
when_it_whiffs: needs a target within 250 studs
description: Aims at a target within 250 studs and fires three rainbow beams that home in. Base cost 3 months; each extra Energy Output level adds 1 month and 1 projectile, up to 7 months for 7 projectiles.

name: Absolute Destruction
combo: stomps into a leap and slam
description: The giant mech stomps, leaps and slams. Costs 1 month, up to 5 months (+1 month per extra Energy Output level). No range or blockability was found.

name: Technique Charge
damage: 20 for the charge, +1 per Energy Output level; 5 for the simple domain
description: Awakening move with a charge hit and a simple-domain component. The wiki's cost table (up to 1 year 10 months) came through garbled, so the mechanics are unclear.

name: Absolute (awakening)
description: Puppet Master's awakening, added in V1.70: the small puppet is swapped for a giant mech with Miracle Cannon, Pigeon Viola, Absolute Destruction and Technique Charge, and Energy Output on the special. HP goes from 85 to 117. Moves cost stored energy measured in months. Passive Energy Reserves: a second Awakening bar starts charging 1.5x faster once the main bar is full.
